name: OpenRouter
note: Sign in, create an API key, then paste it below.

name: Groq
note: Create an API key in GroqCloud.

name: NVIDIA NIM
note: Sign in, select a model and use Get API Key.

name: xKiro
note: Sign in and create a key in your account dashboard.

name: Dahl
note: Sign in and create a key. Setup enables live allowance checks for this key. Dahl is manual-only in the default catalogue; choose a Dahl model alias explicitly.

name: Codiv
note: Create an account, then create a key in the dashboard. Chat uses the text-generation quota.

name: Kilo Gateway
note: Get a key from the Kilo dashboard, or explicitly choose anonymous free-model access.

name: BlockRun free models
note: The free-model route supports anonymous access. Wallet signing and paid wallet routes are not implemented.

name: OVH AI Endpoints
note: Use your AI Endpoints account token. Confirm the endpoint and model in your OVH account; availability depends on region.

name: LLM7
note: Sign in and obtain an API key. Account pages require browser access.

name: Typhoon
note: Open the Playground from the guide, sign in and choose API Keys.

name: Ollama Cloud
note: Create an Ollama Cloud API key. This connection uses cloud inference and does not download a local model.

name: Public AI
note: Obtain a key from your account. Confirm the current API endpoint in the provider's dashboard. Trial credit is finite.

name: Agnes API Hub
note: Sign in to API Hub and create a key. Account-page access and inference have not been verified in this release.

name: Onomeo
note: Choose Get API key and create a key in your account.

name: OpenAI-compatible account gateway
note: Use a key and endpoint for your own compatible gateway. For the direct OpenAI API, use its API Keys page and https://api.openai.com/v1, then update models.json with model IDs available to your account. A ChatGPT subscription is separate from API billing.

name: FreeLLMAPI gateway
note: Deploy your own gateway using the project instructions. Enter its API base URL and gateway key, not an upstream provider key. Configure providers in that gateway separately.

name: OmniRoute gateway
note: Deploy your own gateway, open its dashboard, configure upstreams and create a gateway API key. Enter its base URL below. Create an auto combo or update the catalogue to match your combo.

name: 9Router gateway
note: Deploy your own gateway, configure its upstreams and create a gateway API key. Enter its base URL below. Gateway model IDs must match your own installation.
